summary: Examples of to_uuid with a custom namespace and the default Ansible namespace.
questions: What's an example of to_uuid with a custom namespace?

answer_card.title: to_uuid examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
uuid: "{{ string | to_uuid(namespace='11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555') }}"
uuid: "{{ string | to_uuid }}"   # default Ansible namespace
```
